comment.comment:
Almost everything in GTA is becoming a memecoin. Lucia, Jason, Macca, a cat, a dog, etc.

So why wouldn’t a crypto cult with its own cryptocurrency in the game become a meme in this ecosystem?

First, understand what AudaCity represents.

AudaCity is not a regular “company.”

It’s a brand built around the audacity to pull off bold, daring, and sometimes downright shameless stunts.

Audacity: The willingness to take bold risks, challenge conventions, and do things others wouldn’t dare to attempt.

As seen in the Rockstar trailer, AudaCity has its own token: DacityCoin.

The token is directly connected to the antics, identity, and culture of the AudaCity group.

This is where the distinction matters.

If you create a memecoin called $AudaCity, based on the AudaCity group, it doesn’t quite make sense. They already have a token. It’s called DacityCoin.

On the other hand, if you create a token called $Dacity or $DacityCoin, but leave AudaCity out of the equation, you’ve also missed the mark.

The key is connecting the two.

$DacityCoin — Powered by AudaCity.

There is no DacityCoin without AudaCity.

What makes this connection interesting, and what gives it potential beyond the GTA 6 launch, is staying true to the game’s branding and lore.

AudaCity isn’t a one-off reference. It’s a group with a brand, an identity, and a token that can continue to be part of the GTA universe.

AudaCity will be pulling off antics and pumping its DacityCoin for years to come.

You can buy whichever twisted interpretation of the narrative you prefer.

But at the end of the day, 
it’s DacityCoin powered by AudaCity.
